evidence: Measured on the frozen task bytes (.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/task). (1) TOML: Python 3.13 tomllib.load succeeds on task.toml (keys schema_version, artifacts, task, metadata, agent, environment, verifier), tests/scoring.toml (gates render/constraints 0.0, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, floors functional 0.05) and all five judge.toml files with criterion counts render 1, constraints 1, functional 16, polish 5, visual 4; each judge.toml has [judge], [scoring] and criteria, and its prompt_template = "prompt.md" resolves to an existing file in the same folder. The scoring.toml dimension names match the tests/gates/{render,constraints} and tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual} folders. (2) Shell: `bash -n` exits 0 on solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh; both start with #!/bin/bash; `file` reports 'Bourne-Again shell script, ASCII text executable'. A byte scan of every file in the frozen task finds no CR byte, no UTF-8 BOM and no file missing a final newline. In the source tree, `git ls-files --eol projects/kittle-matter-chat` reports i/lf w/lf for all 32 files, and .gitattributes forces `*.sh text eol=lf` (lines 62 and 78) although core.autocrlf=true. (3) Python tools: py_compile succeeds on tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py; test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py and tests/Dockerfile match the frozen template byte-for-byte (diff empty). (4) Seed/JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/seed/seed_data.json (byte-identical, sha256 f69616e2...) and package.json parse as JSON. (5) Reference entry: `node --check` (v24.19.0) passes on solution/app/server.js and public/app.js. The entry contract agrees across files: test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js; test.sh:97-111 launches `node /app/server.js` with PORT=3000, DB_PATH and NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; server.js:10-14 requires express/better-sqlite3 and reads PORT/DB_PATH; server.js:42 serves /api/health, which test.sh:48 probes; server.js:519 listens on 0.0.0.0. environment/Dockerfile installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, matching package.json, and integration.md:3 states the same entry, port, NODE_PATH and DB_PATH contract. (6) Would run: my own boot smoke in a fresh container (qc-r2-row51-smoke, removed afterwards). I used cw-editor-agent-r3, which has node v22.23.2, express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1, the same pins as the task Dockerfile. The frozen solve.sh mounted read-only exited 0. The app ran as uid 65534 under env -i from cwd /tmp, like test.sh. GET /api/health returned 200 {"ok":true,"booted":true,"clock":"2026-05-12T11:00:00Z"}, GET / returned 200, and app.log shows 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat on port 3000'. Separately, the raw-evidence-index entries' sha256 values match the current files on disk (run_golden.sh b61aa378..., functional.cjs 63858133..., golden-run.log 23943bf8..., functional-before/after and restart-pids), and their matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen solution bytes. golden-run.log records 18/18 scripted checks PASS across a real process restart, ending 'exit 0'. Run verdict CONFIRMED for parse and boot. Counterexamples tried: a broken submission without /app/server.js or with outside symlinks makes test.sh write the zero reward and exit 0 (lines 60-90), so the gating stays well-formed. A conforming app that follows integration.md (server.js, port 3000, global modules via NODE_PATH, DB_PATH) is launched the same way the golden is, so this row finds no entry mismatch that would fail it. Out of scope for this row and not measured here: a full configured test.sh/RewardKit judge run, an Oracle or model score, and a build of the task's own environment/Dockerfile (the boot used a borrowed image with identical pins). None is needed for this row's parse/entry checks, and none is claimed.
